from.place: Since the finite ring $\Lambda=P_n$ is annihilated by an integer, $F_{\Et}$ is a torsion abelian sheaf, so the classical input of the source note (Th. 1.1 of SGA 4 1/2 and [Tag 095U](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/095U)) applies to $f_{\Et}$: the sheaves $R^qf_{\Et,*}F_{\Et}$ are constructible and zero for $q>2e$.

title: Constructibility of etale compact-support candidates over a qcqs base
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $f:X\to Y$ be separated and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $p$ proper and $f=pj$, and write $Rf_!^{(j,p)}K=Rp_*j_!K$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], where $j_!$ is applied termwise [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and $Rp_*$ is the derived direct image for $\Lambda$-module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] have constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Then $\mathcal H^q(Rf_!^{(j,p)}K)$ is a constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $Y_{\Et}$ for every $q\in\mathbf Z$.
